# Prometheus Hyperscale and Conduit Power Form Partnership to Accelerate Speed-to-Market for AI Data Centers in Texas
Prometheus Hyperscale and Conduit Power announce partnership to deliver reliable hybrid bridge and back-up power solutions for data center builds to be co-located at certain carbon-free energy facilities owned and operated by ENGIE in Texas.
